svg.title: Подъём на носки в Смите — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Smith machine calf raise. Show a recognizable compact dual-upright Smith rack with TWO vertical guide rails and a single straight bar with its sleeves engaged on rails, bar across upper back, hands hold bar. Both balls of feet on edge of a low block. START heels below platform height with knee almost straight. FINISH heels clearly raised above platform and bar slides up its rails; balls of both feet stay on the same edge, no change in trunk angle. Three-quarter side view with visible heel-to-step geometry. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
